property_summary: For any successful Collect(_am) where the caller's pre-call balance B and the collected amount A satisfy B >= MinSum and B >= A, the caller's post-call public balance must be B - A (the reference); the mutant sets it to zero, so any partial collection (A < B) violates this rule.
change_summary: Replace the balance subtraction with direct assignment to zero, so collecting any amount clears the entire balance after the external call returns.
